3.2.2.2 ModeRequestPorts defined by the standardized interface of the BswM
In the BswM configuration, the mode request sources have to be defined. The following ModeRequestPorts are implicitly defined by API of the BswM. This subsection summarizes the port interface. The following ModeDeclarationGroups are defined in the particular SWS documents of the AUTOSAR specification as C-Enums. Nevertheless they are referenced here in form of BswM configurations which act as a base for the rest of this document. Refer to the definition of C-Enums in the SWS documents for the definition of modes.
